title: JITServe: SLO-aware LLM Serving with Imprecise Request Information
authors: Wei Zhang; Zhiyu Wu; Yi Mu; Rui Ning; Banruo Liu; Nikhil Sarda; Myungjin Lee; Fan Lai
affiliations: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Google, Cisco Research

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM request schedulers focus on aggregate performance metrics like throughput or average latency, failing to meet diverse application-level SLOs (latency-sensitive, deadline-sensitive, compound) and struggling with unpredictable request information.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 請求 scheduler 著重於吞吐量或平均延遲等整體指標，無法滿足多樣化的應用層 SLO（延遲敏感型、截止期限敏感型、複合型），且難以應對不可預測的請求資訊。

key_innovation.en: JITServe, an SLO-aware scheduler that uses imprecise request information (quantile-based upper-bound length estimation and pattern-graph matching) and a Grouped Margin Goodput Maximization (GMAX) algorithm to allocate just-in-time bandwidth.
key_innovation.zh: JITServe 是一個 SLO 感知 scheduler，利用不精確的請求資訊（基於分位數的長度上界估計與模式圖匹配），並以 Grouped Margin Goodput Maximization（GMAX）演算法進行 just-in-time 頻寬分配。

baselines_compared: vLLM, Sarathi-Serve, Autellix, Learn to Rank (LTR)

key_improvements.en: 1.4x-6.3x service goodput improvement, 28.5%-83.2% resource savings, near-oracle performance.
key_improvements.zh: 服務 goodput 提升 1.4x–6.3x，資源節省 28.5%–83.2%，效能接近理論最優。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Chatbot, Deep Research, Agentic Code Generation, Math Reasoning
traffic_pattern: Continuous batching, Pipeline Parallelism, Request dependencies
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-14B, Qwen3-30B-MoE-A3B, Llama-3.1-70B
